name: Push banner
author: Brett
description: A banner listing every branch that isn't on main yet in AmberX-AXF and axHub (commits ahead/behind, age, last commit, its open PR and that PR's CI), with Open PR and Merge: every change reaches main only through its PR (one is opened for every branch), brought up to date with main and re-tested before it merges (not behind, CI passed on the pinned head; re-checked on the server). Auto-merge takes ready PRs oldest first, one merge per round, and sets branch protection on main where the token may. Auto-land (land/land.mjs, plain scripts on the VPS, no model calls) lands every finished build: worktree cleaned, main merged in with the builds files newer-wins, PR opened, CI started, merged here in dependency order once green and not held by UI Review; blocked builds are pushed to Brett once, in plain words. The console server talks to GitHub with its own token, which never reaches the browser.

items.title: Auto-land: every finished build
items.description: Every finished build the pipeline lands, in landing order, with its PR, state and what it waits on.

items.title: Auto-land: blocked builds
items.description: Finished builds that are not landing, each with the reason in plain words (UI waiting, CI red, conflict, dependency).

items.title: Auto-land: land a build now
items.description: Land one finished build at the next round (within 3 minutes), ahead of the rest; a hold on it is released.

items.title: Auto-land: hold a build
items.description: Keep a finished build from landing until it is released.

items.title: Auto-land: release a held build
items.description: Let a held build land again.
